- [LERR.1.2.6] A response the adapter cannot deliver in the shape it
  published: the adapter emits a `CallError` from the standard families
  ([LECC.2.2]) — `internal.*` when the fault is its own, `adapter.*`
  when the upstream answered unusably. The engine performs no decode of
  its own: a response is a fact of the service's response schema, and the
  adapter asserts it ([LCRS.4.3.1]).
